name: Alkari Survivalist [Racial]
body:
Sometimes you have to go by the old alkari adage: use everything against everything.

Prerequisite(s): Karkus native human, Survival 5 ranks

Benefits: You can notice natural traps and hazards with Survival instead of Perception, and when attacked in the surprise round, you may make a Survival check. If you meet or exceed the highest initiative roll, you may also act in the surprise round. For the surprise round, treat your initiative as +4 higher when determining turn order. This does not carry over to normal initiative.

A Land Out of Time 2013, Little Red Goblin Games LLC, Authors: Caleb Aylsworth, Scott Gladstein, Dayton Johnson, Caleb Aylsworth, Jeremiah Zerby
